svg.title: Swaption smiles from the fitted SABR cube
svg.desc: Normal volatility against strike offset from the forward. Top: 1y, 2y, 5y and 10y expiries into 5y swaps, fitted smiles with the market quotes. Bottom: the two grid nodes with no quotes, fitted smiles against the vols the generating cube would have quoted. Values in docs/vol_cube.csv.
svg.text: Normal volatility by strike offset from the forward swap rate. Dots are the market quotes the cube was fitted to.
Strike offset from the forward, bp
Nodes with no quotes, filled from their neighbours
These smiles come only from the smoothness penalty. Open circles are what the market would have quoted (not used in the fit).
Strike offset from the forward, bp
